{{short description|Computer scientist}}
'''Brigitte Jaumard''' is a computer scientist and expert on [[mathematical programming]]. She earned a doctorate in 1986 from [[ENST, today ParisTech]] under the supervision of Michel Minoux. She was a professor at [[Polytechnique Montréal]].{{r|mg}} from 1989 until 2000. She is now a professor in the department of computer science and software engineering at [[Concordia University]],{{r|concordia}} where she is the holder of an Honorary Concordia Research Chair in Optimization of Communication Networks.{{r|chair}}
